levels.name: Leo, 24, Barista
levels.story: The 8 levels of online dating. Level 2. 12 Matches sind nur Müll für die Mülltonne, du armseliger Barista. I wiped down the sticky counter while aggressively grinding organic espresso beans, my citrus skin raw and burning from the relentless steam machine pushing out orders for ungrateful prats. That arrogant broccoli man stomped over, snarling and sneering as he slammed his dirty knuckles against the wood. He snatched the tip jar right off the counter, pocketing my hard-earned cash in front of everyone while making a vile gagging face, telling me my coffee tastes like swamp water and my life is a dead-end joke. You are just background noise in someone else's love story. My phone buzzed on the cash register with an alert that changed everything and tore my sanity apart. Das siehst du in Level 3. You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Mia, 26, Marketing Assistant
levels.story: The 8 levels of online dating. Level 3. Mit 45 Matches wirst du für den Abschaum der Club-Rückseite aufgespart. I adjusted my smooth avocado skin in the elevator mirror, smoothing down my cheap $35 Zara dress while waiting for the tenth floor. Suddenly, that stuck-up pineapple woman stepped in, blocked the door, pulled out her phone, and started filming me live to her thousands of followers. Look at this pathetic discount avocado trying to ride the elevator with adults, she laughed right into the camera, zooming in on my trembling face and my mediocre forehead badge. People with your pathetic number only get the weekend leftovers and garbage bins. The elevator doors chimed open to an exclusive rooftop party where everyone pointed and stared. Das siehst du in Level 4. You'll see that in Level 4.

levels.name: Zack, 28, Fitness Trainer
levels.story: The 8 levels of online dating. Level 4. 85 Matches und trotzdem einsam im Dreck, du Betrüger. I stood in the exact same sweaty downtown gym where that bitter lemon man had just publicly humiliated me minutes earlier, kicking my heavy coconut shell dumbbells across the rubber floor while he deliberately snatched my weights and hid them under the bench. You have eighty-five matches and zero genuine connections, you absolute fraud, he shouted across the room for everyone to hear while filming my failure on his phone. My phone lit up with an unsent message from an unknown number parked outside in the shadows. Das siehst du in Level 5. You'll see that in Level 5.

levels.name: Basil, 35, System Architect
levels.story: The 8 levels of online dating. Level 8. Das System ist tot, und du bist ab sofort wieder bei Null. I sat in the dark server control room surrounded by glowing blue fiber-optic cables, my forehead displaying the infinity symbol that controls every single dating score in the metropolis. That resilient strawberry woman walked right up to the main console, looked me dead in the eye, and laughed in my face while demanding total system deletion. Are you ready to delete the system and start over with zero? I slammed my hand down on the master override switch, wiping the corrupt database clean as every fake number across Swipe City crashed to zero. What theme should we explore in the next series?
